nodes.label: Unknown-step software preparation — 2026-11-10
nodes.status: Software fixtures qualified; no Gazebo, optimizer or hardware started in this work

nodes.label: Common103 v2 50k historical checkpoint branch
nodes.status: Training completed; job failed during evaluation; not promoted
nodes.summary: Seed 11 resumed from 40k, added 10,000 steps, reached global/replay 50,000 with 39,998 critic and 19,999 actor updates. Segment had 62/71 old-task successes plus 60 censored steps. Of 1,893 original-manifest files, 1,892 matched; evaluation_progress.json differed. Original evaluation contains only 6_B0 and 6_Classical_scheduled; the latter stopped at approximately 0.6804 m before the 0.95 m marker. Four extra evaluation directories lie outside the original manifest.
nodes.rationale: This resumed branch is not multiple independent seeds, a six-run valid benchmark, held-out testing or evidence for the new unknown-step goal task. The feasibility failure does not prove TD3 actor failure.

nodes.label: TraversalScore physical task scoring
nodes.summary: Scores physical goal, heading, path, deadline, stall, intervention and continuous stop. Clearance uses a conservative full robot box including caster sweep and body orientation. Source/header and decision clocks stay separate; invalid, stale or future measurements raise UnknownTaskData.
nodes.rationale: Center/axle crossing or estimator arrival is insufficient. Missing data must not become zero, success or an invented failed replay transition.

nodes.label: TraversalReward task objective
nodes.status: Explicit reward weights required; no accepted run weights at this preparation stage
nodes.summary: Objective covers goal progress, path/heading, time, accepted correction and outcomes.
nodes.rationale: Nominal velocity ISE alone no longer represents the chosen task.

nodes.label: SensorOnlyCommonAdapter Goal100D/1D contract
nodes.summary: 20 features × 5 frames form 100D observations. One common velocity residual has ±0.02 m/s authority; differential remains zero. Reuses projection while retaining requested/replay action separately from accepted correction; excludes scheduled-stop, obstacle position, contact and GT features.

nodes.label: EstimatedGoalReference estimator follower
nodes.summary: Follower uses the estimator and known route/goal, stopping at estimated goal rather than fixed 6/8-second schedules.
nodes.rationale: The independent physical scorer may still fail a rollout when estimator error causes stopping at the wrong location.

nodes.label: UnknownStepEnv transition and checkpoint identity contract
nodes.summary: Synthetic-backend Gym environment exposes reset/step/spaces and 100D/1D requested actions. Checkpoint identity pins task, reward, controller and environment source. Task deadline is terminal failure; external cutoff is censored/truncated. Missing-data boundaries create no transition; valid-data projection faults remain explicit failures.
nodes.rationale: Matching tensor dimensions alone does not establish checkpoint compatibility.

nodes.label: Software and Studio qualification before Gazebo
nodes.summary: 50 task/environment software tests and 32 Studio/evidence checks passed. SIM-R4 reports software checked, Gazebo not yet checked. At this stage no physical Gazebo adapter, extracted URDF envelope, locked bank/released protocol or new-task optimizer/evaluation existed.
nodes.rationale: Synthetic numbers and passing software fixtures are not measured robot geometry, accepted operating thresholds, Gazebo rollouts or training release.
